column1: # The portal at 32 px (mods/portals; the 8-frame loop is built in code from the tile, portal_anim.py) and the mailbox (mods/portals on Phase 3's branch, not in dev).
# Both @-: installed by hand into mods/portals. p_portal: BLOCK_LIKE=obsidian   p_mailbox: BLOCK_LIKE=planks_oak,iron_block,gold_block
# The mailbox is a model box x 3-13, y 0-14 of 16: its front and side show only x 6-25, y 4-31 of the 32 px square, its top the middle 20 x 20.

column3: portal@-|cube|A swirling magical portal surface: soft spiralling bands of violet and magenta light (#2a1240 #4a2278 #7a3ab8 #a868e0 #d8b0ff) curling around several small whirl centres, a few tiny bright white-lilac sparkles, glowing and smooth, no frame, no border
column4: portal_b@-|cube|A swirling magical portal surface: soft spiralling bands of deep blue, teal and cyan light (#0a2236 #124a62 #22808e #4ab8c0 #b0f0ee) curling around several small whirl centres, a few tiny bright white sparkles, glowing and smooth, no frame, no border

column3: mailbox_front@-|cutout|The front of a small wooden mailbox, drawn as a panel exactly 20 px wide and 28 px tall in the lower middle of the square (x 6 to 25, y 4 to 31, touching the bottom edge), everything outside the panel flat solid magenta. The panel: warm oak planks running across (#4d4035 #6c5c42 #7e694e #957e59), a 2 px dark iron band (#3a3c40 #5a5e64) along all four edges of the panel with tiny rivets at the corners, a brass-rimmed letter slot (#8e6f41 #ddb466, the opening dark #2e2720) 12 px wide across its upper third, and below it a small brass keyhole plate
column4: mailbox_side@-|cutout|The side of the same small wooden mailbox, drawn as a panel exactly 20 px wide and 28 px tall in the lower middle of the square (x 6 to 25, y 4 to 31, touching the bottom edge), everything outside the panel flat solid magenta. The panel: warm oak planks running across (#4d4035 #6c5c42 #7e694e #957e59), a 2 px dark iron band (#3a3c40 #5a5e64) along all four edges with tiny rivets, and a small red-painted iron flag (#8a2a20 #b84a34 #d86a4a) on a round hinge in the upper middle, lying flat along the side, pointing forward
column5: mailbox_top@-|cutout|The lid of the same small wooden mailbox seen from straight above, drawn as a panel exactly 20 x 20 px in the middle of the square (x 6 to 25, y 6 to 25), everything around it flat solid magenta. The lid: warm oak planks (#4d4035 #6c5c42 #7e694e #957e59) with a 2 px dark iron rim (#3a3c40 #5a5e64) and a rivet at each corner, light from the top left
